metadata.title: AI Video Security & Access Control | Vocom AI
metadata.description: Vocom AI video security and access control: real-time threat detection, face and plate recognition, and panic response, running on the IP cameras you already have.

attributes.text: Protecting people places and operations at global scale with
Vocom AI
End-to-end video security and access control that helps your team spot risk early, respond faster, and operate with confidence.
Working with renowned, trusted, and leading enterprises
Physical AI Safety Agents
Real-time intelligence where it matters most
Alerts Without the Setup Work
Describe what you want flagged in plain language, and the system builds the detection for you.
Critical Events, Caught Automatically
Firearms, slip-and-fall incidents, and PPE compliance are covered from day one.
Runs on the Cameras You Already Have
Add intelligence to your existing footage. No hardware swap required.
Alerts the Moment It Matters
Your team knows the second something happens, not minutes later.
Search Your Footage in Plain English
Ask for what you’re looking for and find it across your entire archive.
Face and Plate Recognition, Built In
Matches faces and license plates across every camera on the network.
One System for Every Door

Panic Buttons With Real Range
Coordinated Response Chat
Response teams are connected the second an alert goes out.
Everything in One App
Detect, respond, and close incidents without switching tools.

The moment an incident is confirmed, every site knows.

Every action is logged automatically, ready for compliance review.

Built for Religious Institutions

What Comes With
Vocom AI
Security
Built around how security actually works on the ground.
Simple Integration
Turn your existing IP cameras into AI-powered security devices.
No hardware upgrades needed. Connect and go.
Scale across multiple locations without added complexity.
Explore Our Features
An Alerting System That Thinks
Immediate alerts the moment a critical event happens.

See What’s Included
Frequently Asked Questions
Straight answers to the questions we hear most.

attributes.$control__answer: It transforms existing monitoring systems into intelligent detection platforms, watching for threats across your operations in real time rather than relying on manual review.

attributes.$control__question: Does this replace our existing security monitoring?
attributes.$control__answer: It is designed to enhance your existing systems by adding intelligent detection on top of what you already monitor, rather than requiring a full replacement.

attributes.$control__question: How does it handle high volumes of activity?
attributes.$control__answer: The platform is built to process large volumes of events continuously, so security teams get faster detection without manually reviewing every alert.
Contact the team to discuss your current monitoring setup and where added detection would help most.
